name: Onegai! Maid☆Roid
original_name: おねがい! メイド☆ロイド
source:
In the future mankind succeeded to develop independent type androids, Maid☆Roid as new workers in place of human servants. The family of main character bought one such android as a maid.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-may-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
未来，人类成功开发了独立型安卓女仆机器人，作为人类仆人的替代品。主人公的家人买了一台这样的安卓机器人当女仆。
